2607.21332.title: Phonetic forced alignment for low-resource language varieties: Model training and evaluation on Chengdu Mandarin
2607.21332.paper_summary: Phonetic forced alignment is a key technique in phonetic research, yet existing alignment systems lack specialized models for low-resource language varieties. We address this by training text-dependent and text-independent aligners for Chengdu Mandarin using a 17-hour corpus and a custom G2P dictionary. We trained a text-dependent GMM-HMM model (Chengdu-MFA) and fine-tuned a pretrained audio encoder on frame classification with Chengdu-MFA's pseudo label for text-independent alignment (Chengdu-FC). Evaluation on an expert-annotated test set show that both methods significantly outperform Standard Mandarin baselines. Chengdu-MFA reduced average phone boundary differences by 31.8%, while Chengdu-FC achieved a 61.2% reduction. This work establishes a practical bootstrapping pipeline for developing accurate aligners for under-resourced varieties without labor- and time-intensive manual annotation.
2607.21332.paper_summary_zh: 語音強制對齊是語音研究中的一項關鍵技術，但現有的對齊系統缺乏針對低資源語言變體的專門模型。我們通過使用 17 小時的語料庫和自訂的 G2P 字典，為成都普通話訓練了依賴文本和獨立於文本的對齊器。我們訓練了一個依賴文本的 GMM-HMM 模型（Chengdu-MFA），並在框架分類上微調了一個預訓練的音頻編碼器，使用 Chengdu-MFA 的偽標籤進行獨立於文本的對齊（Chengdu-FC）。在專家標註的測試集上的評估顯示，這兩種方法顯著超越了標準普通話基準。Chengdu-MFA 將平均音素邊界差異降低了 31.8%，而 Chengdu-FC 則實現了 61.2% 的減少。這項工作建立了一個實用的自舉管道，用於開發準確的對齊器，以應對資源不足的變體，而無需耗費人力和時間的手動標註。
